title: Padilla, Go challenge impeachment voting rule before Supreme Court
summary: Senators Robin Padilla and Christopher Lawrence Go have asked the Supreme Court to strike down the lower threshold of votes needed to find Vice President Sara Duterte guilty at her impeachment trial.
